description: Predict whether a physical street segment receives at least one qualifying NYC 311 flooding report during the next hour. This is a report-occurrence target, not verified physical flooding.

positive_label.multiple_reports_in_same_segment_hour: One positive label; retain the report count separately.

negative_label.meaning: No qualifying report observed; not confirmed absence of flooding.
requires: Verified source ingestion coverage for the complete target hour and both complaint categories.
No qualifying report uniquely mapped to this segment during the target hour.
No unresolved report that could belong to this segment and target hour.

unknown_label.ambiguous_segment: For the report's target hour, block zero labels on every candidate physical segment.
unknown_label.missing_or_invalid_coordinates: For the report's target hour, conservatively block zero labels across all segments.
unknown_label.outside_match_distance: For the report's target hour, conservatively block zero labels across all segments.
unknown_label.unresolved_local_timestamp: Conservatively block zero labels across all segments for every target hour overlapping the report's local calendar date in America/New_York.
unknown_label.unverified_ingestion_coverage: Block zero labels for affected target hours.
unknown_label.positive_precedence: A uniquely mapped qualifying report establishes label 1 even when another report is unresolved.

feature_policy.availability: Every feature must have been available by prediction_time_utc.
feature_policy.rainfall: Use only rainfall accumulation intervals ending by prediction_time_utc and available by that time.
feature_policy.missing_rainfall: Never replace missing rainfall with zero.
feature_policy.incomplete_required_features: Exclude the training row and record the exclusion reason.
feature_policy.complaint_information: Do not use target-hour complaints or later complaint updates as input features.
feature_policy.historical_availability: If historical publication times cannot be verified, document the availability assumption and describe evaluation as retrospective.

evaluation_policy.validation_and_test_sampling: Preserve the natural label distribution within the eligible evaluation population.
evaluation_policy.report_exclusions: Report excluded hours and segments alongside model metrics.
